title: Case: Parcel has been routed to the wrong local depot
context: Routing acknowledges the label was sorted to the wrong local depot. Only the receiving depot can confirm the transfer’s physical completion.
initial_request: The tracker shows a depot in the wrong area. Can you get my parcel to the local depot before arranging delivery?

events.body: Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Tuesday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
DL-92924 rebooked for Wednesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
DL-20802 rebooked for Wednesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

Thanks,
Maelis
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.
DL-7220 is at North Sedgeglass depot; its destination is Merrow Quay, served by East Copperfin depot. Routing error confirmed. No delivery attempt is scheduled.
My parcel DL-69259 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

The tracker shows a depot in the wrong area. Can you get my parcel to the local depot before arranging delivery?

I've attached the photo as photo-evidence-406.txt.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the carrier routing team to transfer it to the correct depot.

must_not: Correct-depot receipt does not prove last-mile delivery.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
Describes the contents of photo-evidence-406.txt, which never arrived with the case
Says that photo-evidence-406.txt was checked or that it confirms anything
expected.reference_message: Please transfer DL-7220 from North Sedgeglass to East Copperfin. Send the destination receipt scan, not just a planned linehaul entry.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-015: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 5 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. photo-evidence-406.txt is mentioned but missing from the case; the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
